title: Decontamination of textile effluents via the adsorption process on various raw clay minerals enhanced by ozonation: a modeling approach and optimization
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37803-37819
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA03757J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
K. Hendaoui, S. Ben Ayed, L. Mansour, A. Ben Othman, F. Ayari
This study seeks to characterize three different clays and compare their capability to decontaminate a textile effluent using the adsorption process and to explore the synergistic effects of ozonation on the treatment.
